description: Lists the U.S. telehealth specialties this server covers, with each specialty’s slug, the treatment keys it accepts (for example semaglutide, tirzepatide, trt, sermorelin, nad) and how many programs it has. Use it when you need the exact category slug or treatment key before calling find_programs, or when the user asks what this source covers. Takes no arguments.
name: list_categories
